name: Procedural Terrain Raymarcher
description: An endless, procedurally generated landscape rendered entirely in a fragment shader: layered noise terrain, water, sand, grass, rock and snow, with a mouse-controlled camera.
highlights: Raymarches a heightfield built from several weighted layers of smoothed value noise
Picks materials by height and noise: water with foam, beach, grass, soil, stone and snow
Mouse-look camera built from rotation matrices, with drifting cloud shadows
